title: De scriptura sacra, theses ad disputandum propositae, in scholis theologorum academiae Argentoratensis: de quibus praeside doctore Johanne pappo, XII.et XIII.ianuarii respondebit M.nicolaus herrenbergerus Argentinensis, qui theses ipsas conscripsit.
shelf_note: A Strasbourg Lutheran disputation on Scripture, printed in italic type (theses C–CVII on Schwenckfeldians and Papists). No collection is set, and nothing on the leaf conflicts with the record.
structure_note: The counts disagree: structure.pages_translated is 0, but pages_translated_field is 19 (E2-type instrument disagreement). On this leaf the only page number is a later handwritten folio '59' in the top corner. A handwritten foliation that is sometimes misread could explain the 2 backsteps and 1 repeat, so they probably come from reading the numbers, not from a scan splice.

missing.why: 'fanatics' (fanatici) is a Lutheran polemical term for the radical spiritualists and Anabaptists, not the modern sense; a general reader will not know whom it means

book_verdict: The transcription and translation of this printed thesis page are accurate. The flaws are minor: the OCR calls the page handwritten, the later-hand marginal note is partly garbled and its stub is rendered as 'History', and the Schwenckfeld note adds dates that are not on the page (they are correct, but unsupported). The book's translated-page counts disagree.
